quote: We evaluate by ranking all integrated extractions based on their probabilities, and report area under the curve (AUC). Considering real scenarios where we want to integrate as many extractions as possible while keeping a high precision, we also report Recall and F1 when precision is 0.8, 0.9, or 0.95.
